shortDescription: The Philadelphia Phillies option in Polymarket’s Philadelphia Phillies vs. New York Mets market surged from 46.5% one hour earlier to 71.5%, a 25 percentage point move. According to ChainCatcher, Catcher Predict said the sharp swing may reflect the impact of breaking news.
